text: E ɓee wumu haa ka tawata feeñanaali ɓe no foti e ko Men halki e mofte adinooɓe? Kamɓe hiɓe jinnda e koɗoole ɗi ɓen hoɗunoo e mun e ɓe halkeede, kono ɓe waajitoraali fiyaaku ɓen on. Pellet, no e ngol peƴƴol ɗen mofte halkiranooɓe sabu keeferaaku e geddi mun, tasakuyee dallinorɗo goongugol kon ko Nulaaɓe maɓɓe addani ɓe immorde ka Alla. E ɓee fennuɓe Aayeeje Alla kan nanataa, ɓe jaɓa ɓe waajitora?
